market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $95 and rising yields cap equity upside. Third consecutive losing day signals momentum shift. Yen intervention risk adds volatility. Watch for Fed speakers and CPI data. Energy and defense outperform; tech/growth lags.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle ($31.6T by 2050) and data center buildout provide structural growth. India diaspora flows and M&A activity support EM. However, persistent oil inflation and potential Fed hikes create 6-12 month headwind for rate-sensitive sectors. Energy transition (geothermal, EVs) gains policy tailwinds.
